title: Task batches: index API + PWA panel
notes: Make generated task batches first-class. Add backend API `GET /api/tasks/batches/index` listing batches under `autonovelwriter/runtime/tasks/batches/` (id, created time, task_count, paths), and a PWA panel to display them. Hook WS `tasks_batch_created` to refresh the panel and show an immediate UI notification. Keep this separate from the driver queue under `references/autonovelwriter_dev/`.
acceptance: Backend `GET /api/tasks/batches/index` returns batches with stable fields (batch_id, batch_dir, tasks_jsonl, task_count, created_utc).
PWA displays the batches list and refreshes automatically on WS `tasks_batch_created` without requiring manual reload.
Feature is fully operable without binding extra ports in tests: backend import/py_compile passes, PWA `node --check` passes, and a unit-style call can index batches from disk.
